svg.aria-label: Layers, top to bottom. The Solana network: validators that each keep the same accounts, where some accounts hold programs (your program, the Token Program) and others hold state (token balances, your program's data). Below it, apps (payments, games, markets) send transactions and read accounts through RPC. Below the apps, wallets hold keys and sign. At the bottom, users.
svg.text: the same copy of every account
Store data, like files on a computer
Hold users’ keys: sign in and
